svg.title: Chromosome Crossover History and Its PD Tetrad
svg.desc: Original chromosome mechanism with its PD outcome redrawn using the existing homework ascus. Uppercase A/B in the chromosome artwork correspond to + in the homework; lowercase alleles retain their meaning. The four-spore genotype multiset is preserved. Spore positions and sector colors are schematic.
Each recessive allele contributes its own color; plus alleles remain neutral. Slightly overlapping spores are schematic, not observed pigmentation or meiotic order.
svg.metadata: Packed-spore inspiration: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ascus.gif , public domain micrograph uploaded by Rasbak, originally Pthorpe. New schematic geometry and gene colors.
